title: Lyn Buchanan met by three Nordic men at a diner
place_text: Diner in the US; Colorado Rockies

tellings.quote: He said that he was confronted at a diner that he eats at regularly by three men.

plain: Lyn Buchanan, a former Army remote viewer (someone trained by the military to describe faraway places by mind alone), said he was confronted by three men at a diner where he ate regularly, men the story describes as "Nordic," the tall, fair, human-looking visitors of UFO lore. The philosopher Jason Jorjani tells Michels this as what Buchanan told him: "he was confronted at a diner that he eats at regularly by three men."
